title: Add four to eight short strides after easy runs
summary: Strides are efforts of 20 to 30 seconds at about 85 to 95% effort, run after an easy run with about 2 minutes of recovery between them. Runners Connect says most runners do 4 to 8 strides, 2 to 3 times a week.
benefits: Adds speed work without a hard day
source_title: How Strides Can Help You Run Faster

title: Spread study sessions over time instead of one block
summary: Spaced practice means spreading learning over time instead of concentrating it in one block. INSPIRE at Australian Catholic University reports that it improves learning compared with massed practice.
benefits: Learning improves compared with one block
Spaced retrieval gave better retention than massed retrieval
A 2025 classroom study found scores about half a standard deviation higher

title: Borrow e-books and audiobooks from your library with Libby
summary: Libby is a free app for e-books, digital audiobooks and magazines from your public library. A library card is required, and each library sets its own loan length and borrowing limits.
benefits: Free to borrow with a library card
No late fees: titles return automatically on their due date
Titles can be downloaded for offline reading

title: Try parkrun, a free weekly 5 km in a park
summary: Parkrun is a series of weekly 5 km runs in parks around the world. It is free to enter and open to everybody, and walking it is as welcome as running it.
benefits: Events usually take place at the same time each week
Open to every pace, including walkers
source_title: What is parkrun? A quick guide to the running event for everybody
